title: SOTA or Luck? The Winner's Curse in LLM Leaderboards
raw_text:
arXiv:2611.22227v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Public LLM leaderboards guide model evaluation and adoption, yet the reported performance of top-ranked models can be systematically overstated. This leaderboard winner's curse arises because ranking noisy benchmark scores rewards sampling luck alongside genuine ability. The same selection effect can distort scores throughout the leaderboard, a phenomenon we call the rank-induced bias. We develop an $m$-out-of-$N$ bootstrap to correct for this bias. It assumes a fixed model pool with independent, identically distributed bounded tasks while allowing arbitrary within-task correlation among models. Under exact population tiers separated by positive gaps, we prove that the bootstrap reduces $\Theta(N^{-1/2})$ ranking bias to expected residual bias $o(N^{-1/2})$. reason_zh: 揭示 LLM 榜单的“赢家诅咒”：排名靠前部分是采样运气，对依赖榜单做选型与评测的读者是重要提醒。
summary_zh: 公开 LLM 排行榜是模型评估与选型的重要依据，但榜首模型的报告成绩可能被系统性高估。论文指出这源于“赢家诅咒”：在噪声基准分数上排名，会把采样运气与真实能力一并奖励，且这种选择效应会扭曲整个榜单各位置的分数。作者分析该现象的统计机制，并讨论其对模型评测、榜单解读与选型决策的影响，提示读者谨慎对待榜单上的微小分差。
title_zh: SOTA 还是运气？LLM 排行榜中的赢家诅咒

title: tmol: a GPU-accelerated implementation of the Rosetta energy function for machine learning
raw_text:
arXiv:2611.21857v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Physics-inspired forcefields complement generative machine learning models, showing better generalization beyond the training distribution. However, these forcefields are typically slow to evaluate, and their derivatives are difficult to integrate into ML frameworks. We introduce tmol, a GPU-native PyTorch library implementing the state-of-the-art RosettaGenFF forcefield. tmol supports efficient batched differentiable scoring and whole-structure refinement with up to 362-fold throughput increase (batched). Used as a reward in generative protein design, tmol increases hydrogen bonds and water bridges at designed interfaces.
reason_zh: 把 Rosetta 能量函数做成 GPU 原生 PyTorch 库，让物理力场可直接嵌入 ML 训练流程，实用性强。
summary_zh: 论文指出物理启发的力场能弥补生成式机器学习模型在训练分布外泛化上的不足，但这类力场评估慢、导数难以接入 ML 框架。作者提出 tmol：一个 GPU 原生的 PyTorch 库，实现了当前最优的 Rosetta 能量函数，使力场及其梯度可在 PyTorch 中高效计算，便于与机器学习模型联合使用。
title_zh: tmol：面向机器学习的 GPU 加速 Rosetta 能量函数实现

summary_zh: OpenCode 发布新工具 Browse，让编程 Agent 直接使用用户已登录各类账号的真实浏览器。其形态为一个 Chromium 扩展加一个 MCP server：Agent 在后台开启标签页并收进折叠的标签组，不干扰用户视线，可读取页面、点击、输入、截图与录制标签页。遇到需要登录、二次验证或付款的环节，Agent 会把标签页交还给用户处理。该方案解决了 Agent 复用真实登录态与人工接管衔接的问题，对构建浏览器类 Agent 的开发者有较强参考价值。
